Managed bindings from https://github.com/fmod/fmod-for-unity
Commit da38d508a55f50e9d002d69619ac0f92276dd991 (FMOD 2.02.35).
Only fmod.cs, fmod_dsp.cs, fmod_errors.cs and fmod_studio.cs are included.
Modification: FMOD namespace renamed to SpireFmod to avoid conflicts with FMODUnity.
NativeLibraries.cs supplies platform library names.
Native binaries are NOT included upstream and have NOT been installed.
Obtain matching native libraries from the official FMOD Unity package or Engine SDK.
